subject: Pioneer Health demo — coordinate AE/SE + IT security
messages:
From: Alex Bowman <alex.bowman@pioneerhealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: itops@pioneerhealth.com, priya.desai@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Intro demo (security + ops on call)

Hi Soojin / Jasmine,

I signed up through your self-serve flow this morning — thanks for the quick product docs. We'd like a short 30–40 minute walkthrough aimed at our security and platform teams. High-level requests:

- Show typical deployment options (hosted/dedicated/private) and audit/logging capabilities
- Quick cost/latency conversation for 1M tokens/month baseline
- Time for our IT/security folks to ask architecture questions (15 mins)

Availability: next week looks hairy. Our preferred slots (PST): Tue 11/17 09:30–10:30, Wed 11/18 11:00–12:00. If those don't work, we can stretch to 16:00 PST.

I attached a very short internal checklist for the security team (Pioneer_Health_Prelim_IT_Checklist.pdf).

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Platform
Pioneer Health

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Alex Bowman <alex.bowman@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ethan_park@redwood.com, itops@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Intro demo (security + ops on call)

Hi Alex — great to meet you and thanks for the checklist. I'm Soojin (AE) — happy to run this session with our SE, Ethan. Quick notes and next steps: 

- We can do a 40-minute session that covers product patterns, security controls, and a short Q&A for your IT team.
- I'll propose two firm windows that align with your preferences and include an alternate for timezone fallback.

Proposed windows (all PST / Pacific):
1) Tue 11/17 09:30–10:10 PST (30–40m) — ideal to keep morning for your team
2) Wed 11/18 11:00–11:40 PST (30–40m)
3) Wed 11/18 16:00–16:40 PST (fallback, if morning conflicts)

Ethan: can you confirm SE availability for the two primary windows? If neither works we can flip to Thu morning.

Alex / Priya (cc): if you have a preferred attendee list for the security deep-dive, drop it in reply. I'll send a calendar invite with an ops/bridge link once we lock a time. Attaching a calendar invite (redwood-demo-calendar.ics) once confirmed.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0182

From: ethan_park@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Bowman <alex.bowman@pioneerhealth.com>, itops@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Intro demo (security + ops on call)

Soojin — I'm available for both Tue 09:30 and Wed 11:00 windows. I prefer Tue 09:30 if Alex's IT team can make it. Quick planning note for the session:

- 0–10m: high-level platform + hosting options (hosted/dedicated/private) with typical cost buckets
- 10–25m: demo (KV cache, prefix caching, and runtime fallback behavior)
- 25–40m: security & infra Q&A (audit logs, KMS/HSM integration, VPC options)

Alex — is your IT/security team in PST? If they're EMEA/APAC, we should pick the later Wed fallback so it's not too late for them.

Ethan Park
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Desai <priya.desai@pioneerhealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ethan_park@redwood.com
Cc: Alex Bowman <alex.bowman@pioneerhealth.com>, itops@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 14:43:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: Intro demo (security + ops on call)

Thanks — quick clarification: our platform folks are split across PST (San Francisco) and CET (Berlin) — I (Priya) am in CET. The majority of security leadership prefers no earlier than 16:00 CET (which maps to 07:00 PST) — that pushes you into early morning for Ethan / Soojin.

Our narrow sweet spot (for cross-region attendance) would be:
- Wed 11/18 16:00 CET (07:00 PST) — short and early for your side but allows Berlin + SF to join simultaneously
- Alternatively Wed 11/18 18:00 CET (09:00 PST) — might be even better for us, still within your proposed windows if you can stretch.

If neither is possible, we can split the session (20m product overview for US + 20m security deep-dive with EMEA) but we'd prefer a single alignment.

I attached the IT checklist Alex mentioned; happy to add names for attendees once we lock the time.

Best,
Priya Desai
Head of Security Architecture
Pioneer Health

From: soojin_lee@redwood.com
To: Priya Desai <priya.desai@pioneerhealth.com>, Alex Bowman <alex.bowman@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: ethan_park@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, itops@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Request: Intro demo (security + ops on call)

Thanks Priya — that helps. Ethan: can you do Wed 11/18 at 09:00 PST (18:00 CET) instead of 11:00? It's inside Priya's preferred window and lands nicely for EMEA.

If Ethan is good, I'll draft a single 40-minute invite for 11/18 at 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET and include an agenda + ops bridge. Priya/Alex — please confirm headcount for security + platform (just names + titles is fine).

If we need a backup: Wed 11/18 07:00 PST / 16:00 CET is acceptable but we'd prefer to avoid splitting.

Soojin

From: ethan_park@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, Priya Desai <priya.desai@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Alex Bowman <alex.bowman@pioneerhealth.com>, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, itops@pioneerhealth.com
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Intro demo (security + ops on call)

Confirmed — I can do Wed 11/18 09:00 PST / 18:00 CET. Please include the following in the invite:

- 40-minute duration
- Teams link + dial-in + ops bridge (I'll bring logs/trace examples)
- Attendee list for security and platform (names + roles)

Soojin — once you post the invite I'll drop the short runbook and a one-page architecture slide to the Drive link you shared.

Ethan
